name: trigger_interrupt
description: Apply an interrupt decision to the suspended role instance flagged for your loop check. 'continue' resumes it unchanged; 'redirect' injects your reason as a user message into its conversation, then resumes it; 'abort' finishes it with a loop_detected error. The only valid targetRole is the flagged instance id named in your task; the tool rejects any other instance. Use after investigating with the inspection tools.

detailed: Applies an interrupt decision (continue, redirect, or abort) to a suspended role.
friendly: Decide what happens to an interrupted role.
whimsical: Bang the gavel on a paused worker.
{source} is reaching for the red button

detailed: tool {participantRole} is applying the interrupt decision

targetRole.description: The role-instance id flagged for this loop check (given in your task); any other instance is rejected.

action.description: The interrupt decision: 'continue' (resume unchanged), 'redirect' (inject reason as guidance, then resume), or 'abort' (finish the target with a loop_detected error).

reason.description: For 'redirect', the guidance message injected into the target's conversation. For 'abort', the explanation recorded on the error. May be empty for 'continue'.
